statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of the redirected bitly.com public marketing, product, pricing, article, signup and error templates.

page.framework: WordPress marketing MPA plus embedded custom elements and a separate signup app
page.notes: bit.ly redirects to https://bitly.com/. Consent state materially affects first view.

artifacts.caption: Exact 58-check coverage manifest with catalog checksum.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared normal and dark screenshots and probed media/CSS state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation produced the same visual/bytes; no dark rules and color-scheme is normal.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and inspected active animations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The condition matched and document.getAnimations() returned no running animations on load.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured prefers-contrast: more and inspected contrast rules plus Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Controls and text remain visible under increased contrast; stylesheet probing found a contrast media rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected runtime/CSS for View Transition use across MPA routes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS was found and tested route changes use ordinary full-page navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected runtime and CSS for scroll-linked effects.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scroll-linked animation was present on sampled paths, so there is no such effect to implement declaratively.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked motion was observed on the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed mobile screenshots and interactive controls for gesture-driven UI.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative paths use links, forms and buttons rather than custom swipe/pull interactions.
checkOutcomes.reason: No gesture-driven interaction is part of the sampled public flows.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared long-page layout with scroll-state/timeline feature probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is 8,568 px tall but offers static chrome and no scroll-state/timeline cue.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed sampled states for tooltips or tethered popovers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or anchored transient overlay was presented in the sampled journeys.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay was encountered in the exercised paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first-view screenshots, CTA labels and skip navigation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: First views have strong descriptive headings/CTAs, and the DOM contains a Skip Navigation link.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured on-load screenshots across four marketing templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The consent surface obscures most of the mobile viewport on home, pricing and article routes.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlay DOM primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The visible consent overlay is implemented with neither dialog nor popover (counts are both zero).

checkOutcomes.method: Dismissed consent and reviewed the content/chrome proportion.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After dismissal, primary content dominates the viewport and header chrome is compact.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured desktop/mobile overflow and reviewed mobile templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 360 px, horizontalOverflowPx is 0 and all sampled mobile templates reflow without clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected accessible stylesheets for @container usage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container query was found in the loaded accessible CSS despite reusable modules.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured visible target bounds and programmatically focused the first control.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus outline is visible, but 81/95 controls have a dimension under 44 px, including a 38×38 menu.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first view, headings, navigation labels and CTAs across core templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, product, pricing, article and signup views communicate purpose and expose a clear next action.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked from public CTAs to signup without creating an account.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The CTA leads to a concise labelled account form with email/password and Google options; no dead end appears before the irreversible account-creation step.

checkOutcomes.method: Submitted the empty signup form and loaded a missing URL.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Signup exposes a clear email error and password requirements; the 404 explains the error and corrective action.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse, trace and layout observers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse LCP is 23.39 s with CLS 0.112 and TBT 251 ms; trace LCP is 7.31 s.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts in desktop/mobile and corroborated with Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CLS ranged from 0.084–0.112 with late shifts around 2.6–3.8 s.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured long tasks/TBT with Lighthouse and trace.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse TBT is 251 ms; trace captured an 81.85 ms long task.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and confirmed parser-inserted stylesheet placement from DOM metadata.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 166 requests transfer 3.88 MB, with 24 stylesheets and a long parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority CSS chain.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse code-coverage opportunities and HAR.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Estimated waste is 704 KiB JS plus 447 KiB CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and inspected forms/buttons.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reported no label or image-alt failures; signup controls have visible labels and controls have accessible text/ARIA.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse color contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A preheading measures 4.19:1 instead of 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected headings/landmarks/focus and ran Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Landmarks and focus outline exist, but home/product lack H1 in probes and Lighthouse reports skipped heading levels.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually reviewed desktop and mobile typography across templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body copy has comfortable line length/spacing and no sampled text clipping; mobile headings wrap clearly.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked viewport policy, 360 px reflow, Lighthouse target-size and media inventory.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport allows scaling, pages reflow without overflow, Lighthouse target-size audit has no failing nodes, and no media needing captions was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse console audit on normal load.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two identity-related errors were logged on unauthenticated public load.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed doctype/charset and ran image audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 pass, but 22 images lack dimensions and 10 are oversized.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed Lighthouse deprecation, BFCache, prompt and inspector diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Deprecation/BFCache/prompt checks pass, but a broken Snowplow source map and Optimizely cookie inspector issue remain.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed title/description across representative templates and ran Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, product, pricing and article have unique descriptive titles/descriptions; SEO score is 0.92.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected hrefs/viewport/robots and ran Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Real descriptive hrefs and viewport meta are present; robots welcomes general crawlers and Lighthouse found no crawlable-anchor failures.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected canonical/robots/hreflang and fetched robots/HTTP status.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Public samples return success, expose canonicals, localized alternates and indexable robots policy; robots lists two sitemap indexes.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected JSON-LD and social metadata against visible content.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home/product/article expose JSON-LD; home has complete Open Graph/Twitter image metadata matching the visible Bitly entity.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers, cookies, secrets and HAR primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS and X-Frame-Options pass with no exposed secret, but CSP and nosniff are missing.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran trackers/HAR/Lighthouse third-party diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 19 third-party origins, five known trackers, and an Optimizely third-party cookie were observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected signup auth/autocomplete and Lighthouse permission-on-load audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompts fire on load, but signup has password/SSO only, no passkey signal, and empty autocomplete.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected main response security policies.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present; CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran discoverability/no-JS raw HTML comparison.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 91% of rendered content words exist in raw HTML; the site is not a JS shell and title/description survive without JS.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed responsive overlays/navigation and error states across viewports.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Sampled routes remain usable without cut-off horizontal content and the missing route resolves to a stable explanatory page.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked page type and manifest/service-worker signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This is a public marketing MPA, not an installable application; no manifest is declared.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline/installability is not proportionate for the sampled marketing and article surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Loaded a representative missing URL and captured its response/state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The server returns HTTP 404 and a clear page explaining the wrong address and how to recover.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected lang/dir, localized links and logical CSS feature use.
checkOutcomes.evidence: lang and localized alternates exist, but dir is absent and no logical spacing/position rules were found.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative rendered content/forms for locale-sensitive data.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No user-facing dates, currencies, measurements or durations requiring locale formatting appear in the sampled core flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled core marketing/signup flow contains no locale-sensitive data value to format.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative content for scheduled or stored time concepts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No event scheduling, recurring time or timezone-sensitive value appears in the sampled flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: No timezone-sensitive task exists in the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed consent, pricing and signup terms visually.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Accept All and Reject All have equal prominence, pricing purpose is explicit, and signup terms are visible before submission.

checkOutcomes.method: Submitted the signup form empty and inspected accessible validation state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After interaction, email receives aria-invalid=true with “Please enter your email address”; password requirements are stated without blame.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected signup input labels and autocomplete tokens.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Email/password labels exist but autocomplete values are empty.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed pricing and pre-account signup surfaces without creating an account.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Pricing intent, free-account action, SSO alternative and linked legal commitments are visible before account creation.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image inventory and HAR resource accounting.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 10 oversized, 15 legacy-format and 20 non-responsive images were detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared shipped scripts/styles and Lighthouse code coverage to page purpose.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The marketing page ships 40 scripts/24 stylesheets with about 1.15 MiB estimated unused code.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured third-party requests/bytes and inspected media/autoplay.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No autoplay media exists, but 19 third-party origins and multiple large tag-manager scripts dominate a 3.88 MB load.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected agent-related navigation and browser WebMCP runtime.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Bitly advertises MCP/LLM integrations, but navigator.modelContext is not used on the sampled browser surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed sampled public tasks for an appropriate local inference use case.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The core shortening, pricing and signup tasks do not require in-browser language-model or summarization inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: On-device inference would not improve the representative core tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline and post heap summaries after ten bottom/top scroll cycles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Node count fell 586,451→585,860 while total self size rose only 35.71→36.06 MB (~1%); closures also fell.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed heap totals and constructor distribution against page complexity.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap summary is ~35.7 MB for the third-party-heavy marketing page and remains proportionate/stable after interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap type/constructor populations and instrumented listeners/timers during repeated scrolling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appears among top retained constructors; node/closure counts do not grow and no new interval was created.

paths.description: Entry and primary marketing template; tested normal, dark, increased contrast, reduced motion, desktop/mobile, no-JS, network, security and repeated scrolling.
Representative product-detail template for the core shortening offer.
Commercial plan-selection template and commitment clarity.
Primary account-creation flow up to, but not including, account creation; exercised empty-submit validation.
Representative HTTP failure and recovery state.

Not covered: localized duplicates, other product/solution pages sharing sampled templates, authenticated product UI, checkout/cancellation, and actual account creation because they require credentials, transactions, or side effects.

findings.summary: The public site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is byte-identical to the normal screenshot (82,752 bytes), and the platform probe reports color-scheme: normal with no prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and major state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS; tested navigation is a conventional MPA swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin marketing routes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state-aware orientation.
findings.evidence: The home page is 8,568 px tall, but the platform probe found no scroll timeline and screenshots show static chrome with no progress or scrolled-state cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state cue or progress affordance on long content routes; avoid a scroll event loop.

findings.summary: The cookie banner obscures most of the first mobile viewport on every marketing template.
findings.evidence: At 360×800, the on-load banner covers the primary content from y=358 through the viewport bottom on home and pricing, and similarly obscures the article.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-respecting consent surface that keeps equally prominent accept/reject controls without covering the primary task.

findings.summary: The consent overlay is custom chrome rather than a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found 0 dialog and 0 popover elements while the screenshots show a modal-like consent surface with custom close and preference controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Represent modal consent settings with <dialog> and declarative close controls, preserving equal accept/reject choices and focus management.

findings.summary: The marketing component system does not use component-level responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The live stylesheet probe found no @container rules; components depend on viewport-level behavior despite many reusable cards and navigation modules.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type and targeted @container rules for reusable card, hero, and CTA modules.

findings.summary: Many visible controls have sub-44px touch dimensions.
findings.evidence: At 360 px, 81 of 95 visible interactive elements had at least one dimension below 44 px; the menu button measured 38×38 and the sign-up CTA 38 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Give primary controls and icon buttons at least a 44×44 CSS pixel hit area while retaining visible keyboard focus.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is far outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 23.39 s, FCP 8.26 s, CLS 0.112 and TBT 251 ms (performance score 0.47); the independent trace measured LCP 7.31 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, shorten render-blocking chains, defer nonessential scripts, and retest under the same mobile conditions.

findings.summary: Late content causes measurable layout shift.
findings.evidence: Layout observation measured CLS 0.084 desktop and 0.088 mobile; Lighthouse measured 0.112, crossing the good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for late banners, images, and embeds; stabilise font fallbacks and consent insertion.

findings.summary: Main-thread work remains heavier than necessary.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 251 ms TBT. The trace found one 81.85 ms long task even though its shorter test window totalled only 31.85 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and split nonessential initialization, especially analytics, experimentation, accessibility-widget, and free-tool integrations.

findings.summary: The load has a large render-blocking and network dependency surface.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 166 requests and 3.88 MB transferred, including 24 stylesheets and 40 scripts; many parser-inserted, VeryHigh-priority stylesheets are render-blocking candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, inline only the critical subset, defer noncritical styles and scripts, and set useful caching.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 704 KiB unused JavaScript and 447 KiB unused CSS, including 93% unused Foundation CSS and 99.9% unused animate.css.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove page-global bundles, tree-shake or route-split integrations, and load third-party features only when needed.

findings.summary: A visible preheading misses WCAG contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 4.19:1 for “GREAT CONNECTIONS START WITH A CLICK OR SCAN” (#777570 on #f7f4ee), below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the text token or adjust the background so normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 in all themes.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy is inconsistent on key marketing templates.
findings.evidence: The home probe exposed no H1 and began with many H3 elements; the URL Shortener probe also found no H1. Lighthouse reported H3 and H5 heading-order failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive H1 per template and nest subsequent headings without skipping levels; keep visual styling separate from heading rank.

findings.summary: The home page logs errors during normal load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a Google Identity FedCM NetworkError and “Not signed in with the identity provider” on a public unauthenticated load.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not initialise sign-in flows until requested; handle unavailable identity state without console errors.

findings.summary: Image delivery has sizing and responsive-source gaps.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 22 images without dimensions, 10 oversized images, 20 without srcset, and 19 below-fold images not lazily loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width/height, responsive srcset/sizes, and lazy loading for below-fold content; verify aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Developer diagnostics include a broken third-party source map and an inspector cookie issue.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse emitted a Snowplow source-map column-out-of-bounds warning and reported an Optimizely client-storage cookie inspector issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Update or remove the affected third-party bundle and verify clean source maps and DevTools Issues output.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but the main response lacks Content-Security-Policy and X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only mode, converge on a restrictive policy, send nosniff, and keep HSTS and clickjacking protection.

findings.summary: The public landing page has a broad tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe saw 19 third-party origins and five known tracker domains; Lighthouse found an Optimizely third-party cookie. The HAR transferred 3.88 MB across 166 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce trackers to demonstrated needs, gate optional vendors on consent, and lazy-load integrations only at the point of user value.

findings.summary: Account creation lacks passkey support and useful credential autocomplete.
findings.evidence: The signup flow offers password and Google SSO, with no passkey/WebAuthn signal; email and password inputs expose empty autocomplete values. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration/authentication and correct email/new-password autocomplete tokens, retaining federated sign-in as a choice.

findings.summary: Several defensive response policies are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers probe found no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; clickjacking protection (X-Frame-Options: DENY) and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict referrer policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, then evaluate CSP frame-ancestors as the modern clickjacking control.

findings.summary: Localized routes exist, but the sampled CSS lacks logical-property and explicit direction support.
findings.evidence: The page advertises eight localized variants and sets lang=en-US, but dir is empty and the stylesheet probe found no margin/padding/inset logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction where needed and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties; test at least one RTL locale.

findings.summary: Signup inputs omit autocomplete assistance.
findings.evidence: The signup probe found labelled email and password fields but both autocomplete properties were empty.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=email (or username where appropriate) and autocomplete=new-password, with password-manager-friendly names.

findings.summary: Several image assets are not delivered at an efficient resolution or format.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 10 oversized images, 15 legacy-format images, 20 missing responsive sources, and 19 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, supply srcset/sizes, and defer below-fold imagery while retaining dimensions.

findings.summary: The home page performs disproportionate work before interaction.
findings.evidence: The HAR shows 40 scripts and 24 stylesheets; Lighthouse estimates about 1.15 MiB combined unused JS/CSS on a marketing landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a page-weight budget, remove unused frameworks/styles, and conditionally initialise analytics and embedded tools.

findings.summary: Third-party code consumes a disproportionate share of the page budget.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 19 third-party origins; Google Tag Manager/gtag resources alone account for several of the largest scripts, while the load transfers 3.88 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit vendor value, collapse duplicate analytics destinations, defer optional vendors, and enforce a third-party byte/request budget.

findings.summary: Bitly markets MCP and AI integrations but exposes no browser-native structured capability on the audited public surface.
findings.evidence: Navigation links prominently advertise Bitly MCP and LLM integrations, making agent readiness applicable, while the runtime probe reports navigator.modelContext absent/unused.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose safe, scoped browser actions with declarative agentic forms or WebMCP tools where public shortening and account flows can support them.

taskList.title: Cut render-blocking and unused third-party code
Replace the viewport-obscuring consent banner with a semantic compact dialog
Deploy CSP and complete defensive response headers
Stabilise late content and reserve image/banner space
Fix heading hierarchy and the failing text contrast token
Add passkeys and correct signup autocomplete tokens
Adopt container queries and logical properties
Clean console, source-map and inspector diagnostics
Add route transitions and long-page orientation cues
Expose safe structured browser agent capabilities
